F214 / PR256 requested first-hour after-deploy audit COMPLETE. Merge a70cace40b002e9940b230b5ca27d6763a72977c, Warn(b), production PID36530. Confirmed same PID/revision near05:09Z and06:10:44Z; process started05:07:56Z. PM requested a05:08:00–06:10:00Z window instead of waiting for the earlier three-day proposal. No longitudinal effectiveness or savings claim follows from this short sample.

Published public-safe report: https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/pull/256#issuecomment-7001369640 . Performance note subject f:214-audit-after, head mergeSHA above, commit ce6adb0292b00dfae16332e57095a9c3b22c8c44; generated basename19-note-f-214-audit-after-a70cace. Role had already been released at merge, so output truthfully records writer_holds_role=false; PM explicitly assigned this audit afterward. No holding changes made.

Window:261delivered,233paired,151decided;76busy+6nonbusy-partial excluded. Report1507calls,307turns,54sessions,14unseated. ShippedWarn modeled guard outcomes: largecoldallowed1,warned0;warmrefused/warned1,refused0;large-refusals2. All233new_guard rows agree with independent computation. Per harness/model/route before-vs-after table in public report includes all15before groups; no-sample after rows marked rather than treated as risk-free. Before7days9402decided is not directly rate-comparable with62minutes151decided.

Exposure gap: no decided large cold5m-TTL case afterdeploy. One5m warm warning: plainCopilotClaude,idle6.37min,nextcallread99.8%. Remaininglargecoldallow: proxiedClaude,idle~26min,native1h,nextcallread8.6%. Do not claim original high-volume5m silent-cold problem empirically solved from this sample.

Actual receipt gap: no send.cold-wake-forced/watchdog.nudge/watchdog.idle-nudge events in window. Direct ordinary-send cold_check attaches AFTER delivery outcome persistence (http/mod.rs and delivery/mod.rs), so delivery spine records do not prove actual warning/refusal issuance. Two reconstructed Cold outcomes are on DELIVERED pairs, not actual request refusals. Daemon restart also clears native context availability; replay uses previous-call prompt sizes, not recorded send-time availability. Pre-window predecessors missing from scoped Claude/OMP reports also exclude pairings. Magic wand: persist compact structured guard outcome/TTL/basis with delivery audit so a future audit compares actual receipts to next-call cache behavior without reading message bodies. This is a proof-gap observation, not an implemented change or blocker added after C34.
